mapper.select:
select dw.fileid, dw.filename, dw.fileurl, dw.extendedname, dw.createdatetime, dw.filetypeid, dw.filecode, dw.filecode2, dw.ssfl, dw.createuserid, dw.updatedatetime, dw.updateuserid, dwt.filetypename, dwt.parenttypeid, cu.username, cd.dicvalue as ssfltypename from dj_workresourcelibrary dw inner join dj_workresourcelibrarytype dwt on dw.FILETYPEID = dwt.FILETYPEID left join cf_users cu on dw.CREATEUSERID = cu.USERID left join cf_dictionary cd on cd.DICTYPEKEY='ssflType' and dw.ssfl = cd.DICKEY where 1=1
and dw.fileName like concat('%',#{fileName},'%')
and dw.FILETYPEID in
#{typeId}
order by dw.createdatetime desc
